summary: Office-retreat hiker left behind by his 15-person group on a Mt. Shavano summit push; disoriented on descent, endured an overnight freezing-rain storm in a gully below Espirit Point, found alive Saturday after regaining cell signal, hospitalized
location: Mt. Shavano northeast slopes toward Shavano Lake; found in gully above North Fork drainage below Espirit Point
responding_agency: Chaffee County Search and Rescue South; mutual aid: El Paso County SAR, Fremont SAR, Western Mountain Rescue Team, CCSAR North, Park County SAR, Teller County SAR, Arapahoe Rescue Patrol, DFPC Canon Helitack, Colorado SAR
notes: Parent-opened run 659 (Denver Post reprint via ems1, 2024). Summited ~11:30 a.m. Friday, group collected the trail markers on their way down; search began ~9 p.m.; extraction Saturday 2024-08-31; full extent of injuries undisclosed. SnowBrains merge run 885: 15-person office-retreat detail; hiker regained cell service in the North Fork gully below Espirit Point and called 911; technical rope extraction; hospital transport.
